# Hand-Crafted Question Template Counts: A Detailed Report on the Reported Template-Construction Effort

## Executive Summary

For the Freebase evaluation, the work uses 500 randomly selected triples and reports 106 hand-crafted templates ([document_2.txt](document_2.txt)). For the in-house power tool domain knowledge base, the paper reports 67 predicates and 103 hand-crafted templates ([document_2.txt](document_2.txt)). Together with the 106 Freebase templates, the authors wrote 209 templates in total ([document_2.txt](document_2.txt)). Therefore, the answer to the query "How many hand-crafted templates did they have to make?" is 209 when considering the entire reported template-construction effort. If the question is limited to the Freebase evaluation alone, the answer is 106. If limited to the power tool domain alone, the answer is 103. ## Introduction and Scope
The query asks for the number of hand-crafted templates that the authors had to make. The paper states that the only human labor in this work is question template construction, and the template construction is therefore the manual component reported ([document_2.txt](document_2.txt)). ## Freebase Evaluation Template Counts

For the Freebase evaluation, the work uses 500 randomly selected triples ([document_2.txt](document_2.txt)). The paper reports 106 hand-crafted templates for those 500 Freebase triples ([document_2.txt](document_2.txt)). The triples share only 53 distinct predicates, so the authors made 2 templates for each predicate on average ([document_2.txt](document_2.txt)). This design ties template creation to predicates, keeping the template set compact relative to the triple set ([document_2.txt](document_2.txt)). The Freebase template count is therefore 106, derived from 53 predicates at an average of 2 templates per predicate ([document_2.txt](document_2.txt)).

### Seed Questions and Retrieval

The experiment also retrieved 1529 more questions from Google ([document_2.txt](document_2.txt)). These 991 seed questions and 1529 retrieved questions are not hand-crafted templates; they are outputs or acquisitions that follow from the templates and the retrieval process ([document_2.txt](document_2.txt)). The hand-crafted template count for Freebase remains 106 ([document_2.txt](document_2.txt)).

## In-House Power Tool Domain Template Counts
